answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the walnut of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the whisper of a task receipt, and the island is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
